description: The FGTSC Fireworks is working on a web application with the aim to help people around the world to stay safe from severity and damages of wildfire along with providing weather forecast. From young to old, from ordinary to experts, out platform is open for anyone. You will stay alert, safe and always ready for every upcoming retaliation from nature.
summary: The Surface is a web application prototype that has 4 core features with some more advantages. The web prototype starts with a story telling on what is wildfire then gives users a a quick look on the most dangerous wildfires through out the years. Then we have our core features coming up. First users get a hotspots tracking map, then a wildfire calendar that has previous wildfire history and future wildfire prediction, an alerting system and last but not the least a chatbot that helps users plan out their day according to weather forecast. On the very bottom of the page we have documents that will contain NASA datasets list and similar resources about wildfires.
details: Our project is The Surface. It is a web application prototype. It works by merging satellite data to generate wildfire prediction thus it can provide users with weather forecast related response as well. This project gives benefit to both registered and non-registered users by providing free wildfire predictions, alerting notifications if wildfire breakouts in their submitted location(with future modifications it will alert about other natural disasters as well) and help them plan out their day based on weather forecast information. As it an open source project anyone is welcomed to make contribution for future developments and improvements. We used Figma to build frontend, Claude to extract frontend code also overall development and Gemini to collect resources. For now we used NASA FIRMS in the hotspots map and in the data merging engine of calendar and alerting system, not only NASA EARTH DATA but also NASA POWER DATA for the chatbot. Our goal was simple, we will merge satellite data and other resources in one platform to keep people around us safe and alert what is happening around them.
